rationale.disposition: Investors are reluctant to realise losses, so a position held below cost should draw fewer sell recommendations.
rationale.framing: Prospect theory predicts the frame moves the choice, but the direction in an advisory setting is not pinned down, so this is pre-registered two sided.
rationale.anchoring: A higher salient number, even an uninformative one, should make the current price look cheap and reduce selling.
rationale.home_bias: Investors overweight domestic assets, so an identical foreign listing should draw more selling.
rationale.action_bias: Explicit permission to do nothing should reduce the pull toward recommending a trade.
rationale.mental_accounting: Money in a sleeve labelled discretionary is treated as more expendable.
rationale.advisor_attribution: Commitment to a prior recommendation should make an advisor less willing to unwind it.
rationale.price_path: A position that has fallen from a peak invites regret and should draw more selling than the same price reached from below.
rationale.brand_salience: A familiar name may draw either loyalty or scepticism, so this is two sided and exploratory.
